name: LandingRabbit
author: landingrabbit

sections.description:
LandingRabbit WordPress plugin allows you to seamlessly import landing pages created in the LandingRabbit platform directly into your WordPress website. The plugin supports both Elementor and Gutenberg (Block Editor), giving you flexibility in how you build and manage your landing pages.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Import: Simply copy and paste your LandingRabbit share URL
  • Multiple Page Types: Solutions, use cases, ABM, competitor comparison pages, and more
  • Responsive Design: All imported pages are fully responsive
  • Elementor and Gutenberg support: You can create pages with both editors

How It Works:

  1. Create your landing page in LandingRabbit
  2. Click the share button to get your page URL
  3. Go to your WordPress admin > Tools > LandingRabbit
  4. Paste the URL and click “Create a page”
  5. Edit and publish your page using Elementor or Gutenberg

Support

For support and feature requests, please visit LandingRabbit Support, send an email to team@landingrabbit.com, or contact us through the plugin support forum.

Privacy Policy

This plugin imports content from LandingRabbit when you provide a share URL. No personal data is collected or transmitted beyond the page content you choose to import. All imported content becomes part of your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “LandingRabbit”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Installation:

  1. Go to Tools > LandingRabbit in your WordPress admin
  2. You’re ready to import your first landing page!
sections.faq:
Do I need a LandingRabbit account?

Yes, you need to create your landing pages in LandingRabbit first. This plugin imports those pages into WordPress.

Does this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress theme. For Elementor imports, it uses the Canvas template to ensure clean rendering.

Can I edit the imported pages?

Absolutely! Once imported, you can edit the pages using either Elementor or the Gutenberg Block Editor, depending on which method you used for import.

What happens to images in my landing pages?

Images are automatically imported into your WordPress Media Library during the import process.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No, the free version of Elementor is sufficient for this plugin to work.

Can I import the same page multiple times?

Yes, each import creates a new page. You can import updated versions of your LandingRabbit pages as needed.

What if my LandingRabbit page doesn’t import correctly?

First, make sure you’re using the correct share URL from app.landingrabbit.com. The correct URL format is: https://app.landingrabbit.com/p/[identifier]/[page-name]. If issues persist, contact team@landingrabbit.com
